The one I can make without thinking, which is the only kind of cooking I
reliably do. Onion, carrot, a bay leaf, the bag of red lentils that's
always in the cabinet. Twenty minutes and it forgives everything.

**Feb 2** — cut the water by half a cup and put the lemon in at the end
instead of the middle. That was the whole problem for a year.

**Mar 9** — did it with the good olive oil. Better, but not better enough
to keep buying the good olive oil for a Tuesday.

summary: Twenty-minute forgiving default, refined over two accretion passes
title: red lentil soup, the base
